from solution import larg_nnum


def test_issue_example():
    """Get the n largest items: example with n=2 returns [100, 90]."""
    result = larg_nnum([10, 20, 50, 70, 90, 20, 50, 40, 60, 80, 100], 2)
    assert result == [100, 90]  # desc: 100, 90, 80, ... top 2 are 100, 90


def test_issue_top_one():
    """Get the n largest items: n=1 returns the single maximum."""
    result = larg_nnum([10, 20, 50, 70, 90, 20, 50, 40, 60, 80, 100], 1)
    assert result == [100]  # max(10, 20, ..., 100) = 100, top 1 is [100]


def test_issue_top_three_descending():
    """Get the n largest items: top 3 are in descending order."""
    result = larg_nnum([10, 20, 50, 70, 90, 20, 50, 40, 60, 80, 100], 3)
    assert result == [100, 90, 80]  # desc: 100, 90, 80, 70, ... top 3


def test_issue_duplicate_maxima_kept():
    """Get the n largest items: duplicate largest values are all kept."""
    result = larg_nnum([5, 1, 5, 3, 5], 2)
    assert result == [5, 5]  # desc: 5, 5, 5, 3, 1, top 2 are 5, 5


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Get the n largest items: works with negative numbers."""
    result = larg_nnum([-10, -5, -20, -1, -8], 2)
    assert result == [-1, -5]  # desc: -1, -5, -8, -10, -20, top 2


def test_issue_float_numbers():
    """Get the n largest items: works with floats in descending order."""
    result = larg_nnum([1.5, 3.5, 2.5, 0.5], 2)
    assert result == [3.5, 2.5]  # desc: 3.5, 2.5, 1.5, 0.5, top 2


def test_issue_n_equals_length():
    """Get the n largest items: n equal to length returns all sorted descending."""
    result = larg_nnum([3, 1, 2], 3)
    assert result == [3, 2, 1]  # desc: 3, 2, 1, all 3 items


def test_issue_n_zero_returns_empty():
    """Get the n largest items: n=0 returns no items."""
    result = larg_nnum([10, 20, 30], 0)
    assert result == []  # n=0 so 0 items: []


def test_issue_empty_list():
    """Get the n largest items: empty dataset returns empty list."""
    result = larg_nnum([], 2)
    assert result == []  # no items available, n=2 gives []


def test_contract_returns_list():
    """Function larg_nnum(list1, n) returns the n largest items as a list."""
    result = larg_nnum([4, 1, 3, 2], 2)
    assert isinstance(result, list)  # expected type is list, e.g. [4, 3]


def test_contract_length_matches_n():
    """Get the n largest items: result length equals n when n fits."""
    result = larg_nnum([4, 1, 3, 2], 2)
    assert len(result) == 2  # n=2 so len is 2; values are [4, 3]
